name: molnar_desordres
promptTemplate: A generative study of Vera Molnar's (Des)Ordres featuring {{grid_density}} grid density with {{concentric_rings}} nested rings per cell, drawn with {{line_weight}}px strokes in {{disorder_mode}} motion over {{paper_tone}} paper with {{perturbation_style}}.

ui.title: (Des)Ordres Studio
ui.tagline: Generative square studies after Vera Molnar

grid_density.hint: Adjust count of square modules across canvas

concentric_rings.hint: Density of nested squares per module

disorder_mode.hint: Pattern of perturbation sweeping the grid

perturbation_style.hint: Method used to deform corners and edges

gallery.blurb: Concentric squares in the spirit of Vera Molnar's (Des)Ordres: a grid of cells each holding nested squares whose corners are jittered, the disorder rising and falling across the grid in a slow wave, fine dark lines on off-white.
gallery.prompt: Concentric squares in the spirit of Vera Molnar's (Des)Ordres: a grid of cells each holding nested squares whose corners are jittered, the disorder rising and falling across the grid in a slow wave, fine dark lines on off-white. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
